superseded_instruction_scope: The original delegated_evidence_instructions sentence that routed raw PDFs/labels requiring source bytes through the existing GitHub Actions -> Release acquisition lane.
historical_record_policy: Do not rewrite the original post-seal task packet. It truthfully records the acquisition policy at the time it was authored. This receipt changes execution routing prospectively only.

current_pdf_policy.locator_verified: Record publisher/document identity, original URL, filename/title/date when supported and verification provenance. Locator existence alone cannot prove an unread claim.
current_pdf_policy.content_verified: If a trusted research surface actually exposed claim-relevant PDF content and a faithful readable representation/locator was preserved, Grounded Evidence may proceed before raw PDF bytes exist.
current_pdf_policy.materialized: A later normal-network Agent may download and verify raw source bytes, then append raw size/SHA/storage metadata to the same logical document. This is optional completeness enrichment unless byte-level/source-format verification is itself claim-relevant.
current_pdf_policy.actions_rule: Do not create or run GitHub Actions merely to download new PDF source bytes. Actions remain valid for CI/PostgreSQL/runtime execution.

blenrep_execution_effect: SV-005 source discovery must not re-enter PDF downloader engineering. Reuse the already-existing legacy Release PDFs where convenient, use preserved webpage/readable material for the other claims, execute the bounded Grounded Evidence trajectory, and defer any missing raw PDF materialization that is not claim-critical.
authority_boundary: Mainstream official/regulatory/issuer/institutional hosting establishes a credible document locator/identity lane, not universal claim authority. Authority remains claim-scoped and same-upstream mirrors remain one evidence cluster.
